name: Eurofurence
blurb: Europe's largest and longest-running furry convention, taking over a Hamburg congress center for fursuiting, art and community programming.

editions.evidence: Page JSON-LD Event: 'Eurofurence 31' 2027-08-18 -> 2027-08-22 @ CCH Hamburg; meta description: 'Eurofurence 31 will take place from August 18th to August 22nd, 2027.'

notes: Community-run furry convention; its full site navigation (Program, Fursuiting, Fursuit Lounge, Photography, Participate, Accessibility Services...) has no guest-of-honor section or guest list, so guests is 'none' rather than an unannounced roster.
